## Reading the evidence

This wiki distinguishes executed instruments, unsigned proposals, firsthand operational records, CRM summaries, correspondence, and assistant digests. Source IDs remain beside substantive claims. A document’s preparation, execution, effective, and term-end dates are distinct. A later note does not by itself amend a signed agreement.

- Executed agreements establish only the terms they expressly set or change; many renewals preserve earlier provisions. Operational rosters, shift labels, door counts, test appointments, and report worksheets are not separate subscriptions. [D024–D033] [D035] [D037] [D039–D044]
- **Unsigned or rejected terms are retained as proposal history**, not accepted commitments: Brackenwater’s October 2025 redline, QFL Amendment No. 2, and Thornbury’s February 10, 2026 review form. [D034] [D036] [D038] [D065]
- Ambiguous descriptions such as “the account Dana runs,” “the account Tobias runs,” and “the account Pree runs” do not uniquely identify an account without contextual evidence. “Account” also refers to software logins, benefits, payroll, expense systems, and Pemberline’s vendor relationship. [D013] [D023] [D057] [D090–D092] [D103] [D109] [D117]
- Several ticket numbers recur across unrelated customers and issues. They must retain customer, site, date, and symptom context, particularly `8841`, `4419`, `4912`, and `PD-88412`. [D002] [D004] [D015] [D030] [D034] [D036] [D039] [D058] [D064] [D073] [D116]
- Source metadata and body dates can conflict: D079’s path/front matter identify September 12, 2025, but its body says the meeting occurred Tuesday, September 16, after Brackenwater’s handoff. D010 attributes a coverage correction to October 4, whereas the actual correction email is dated October 3. Neither discrepancy is silently normalized. [D079] [D010] [D063]

## Seller, policy, and internal roles

### Company and product

Pemberline Systems supplies **Pemberline Dock**, cloud-based yard and dock scheduling software. Described modules include gate check-in, dock-door assignment, carrier appointments, trailer tracking, dispatcher console, gatehouse kiosk, carrier self-service portal, yard spotter tasking, and APIs. Product edition descriptions vary by order; they are not evidence of an account-wide product change. [D024–D030] [D037] [D039]

Pemberline is described as a Delaware corporation in multiple instruments. Its addresses differ across sources: 440 Commerce Way, Suite 900, Chicago in the QFL MSA; 410 Mercer Wharf, Suite 800 in Brackenwater’s unsigned redline; 400 Mercer Waterway, Suite 900 in QFL’s draft; and 400 Mercer Street, Suite 900, Seattle, WA 98109 in Thornbury’s signed renewal. No supplied record explains these differences. [D027] [D028] [D034] [D036] [D039]

### Marketing and customer-data constraints

The QFL MSA permits QFL marks only inside its branded carrier portal. External press releases, case studies, and public customer lists require **prior written consent in each instance**. Pricing, discounts, roadmaps, architecture, and audit reports are confidential; QFL data, terminal layouts, freight volumes, carrier rates, and procedures are customer confidential information. These are QFL-specific contractual terms, not evidence of identical terms for every customer. [D028]

QFL retains its customer data. Pemberline may process it to provide services and may use de-identified telemetry only if it cannot identify QFL, users, terminals, shipping customers, drivers, or be reverse-engineered to reveal customer data. Feedback may be commercialized without attribution or compensation, but resulting updates must not include confidential information or customer data. [D028]

## Brackenwater Freight Co.

### Buyer and operating context

Great Lakes LTL carrier, largely cross-dock coordination in Toledo, with Grand Rapids also identified. Initial setup contacts were receiving, outbound dispatch, and evening yard desks. Greg was Toledo’s night-shift pilot lead; Lena Morcant signed the original order, with no title recorded. The renewal customer signatory is unnamed. No definitive economic buyer is identified. [D001] [D024] [D059] [D035]

### Commercial history

| Record | Draft / execution | Effective term | Terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original signed order | 2024-11-01 / **2024-11-12** | **2024-12-01–2025-11-30** | 60 seats; **$1,700/seat/year**, **8%** discount. Lena Morcant and June signed. [D024] |
| Customer redline, unsigned | Received **2025-10-28** | No executed term established | Proposed **75 seats**, **15%** discount on prevailing list price; CFO approval and hardware-language reconciliation pending. No binding effect without both signatures. [D034] |
| Executed renewal | 2025-11-10 / **2025-11-21** | **2025-12-01–2026-11-30** | **64 seats**, **$1,760/seat/year**, **8%**; gross **$112,640**, discount **$9,011.20**, net **$103,628.80**. Only quantities, pricing, discount, and term dates change. [D035] |

The September 2026 account page and weekly confirm 64 seats and November 30 term end. A February 10 CRM note instead says **December 31, 2026**; this conflicts with the signed renewal rather than extending it. December 2025 weekly rounded ARR to about **$104k**. [D001] [D118] [D051] [D110]

**Unsigned redline operational proposals:** Zebra TC77 backward compatibility without firmware upgrades during Tuesday 22:00 Eastern–Friday 06:00 Eastern peaks at Toledo Doors 14–38 and Grand Rapids West; daily SFTP *Carrier Dwell & Yard Velocity CSV* by **04:30 Central**, with arrival scan, gate pass, door bump, and seal sign-off, following an alleged October 14 Milwaukee South Gate B dispute under `PD-88412`; unlimited Kalamazoo virtual overflow spots without additional logins; Stoneharrow invoices to `ap-freight@brackenwater.invalid`. None is established as accepted by that redline. Its stated BWF administrative address is 1900 Lakefront Industrial Parkway, Toledo; it describes BWF as a Michigan corporation. [D034]

- March 2025: Dana’s “biggest customer” in that weekly context; one duplicate driver record, not a scheduling issue. April: Toledo west-apron repainting left Dock 12–18 schedule/door CSV outstanding. [D100] [D101]
- September handoff: Toledo east-apron **Doors 14–22**, **02:00–06:00** LTL kiosk pilot; Thursday **15-minute** gate-wait/printer checks; `44182` tablet Wi-Fi near Door 22 suspected local AP. Warm-intro preparation was a **30-minute** block. Dana’s historical start remains unknown, oldest CRM import “legacy migration.” [D059]

Identical January PDFs **INV-88310 / INV-88311**, same PO, both generated **02:00**; Stoneharrow webhook retry caused duplicate. ## Quarrendon Freight Lines

### Identity, roles, and footprint

The signed MSA instead identifies principal operational headquarters as **1880 North Terminal Drive, Saint Paul, MN 55101**. Draft Amendment 2 says **1880 North Terminal Road**. These descriptions are not reconciled. [D004] [D028] [D036]

**Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations, is primary customer contact and signed the MSA, seat amendments, and renewal. Shift leads, yard clerks, terminal managers, and lead dispatcher Greg appear as operational stakeholders, not separately established economic buyers. [D028] [D032] [D041] [D044] [D082]

December 4 reply rejected 15%, said remain **12% until renewal talks**. December 8 weekly reports rejection as Friday afternoon, differing from email’s Thursday date. [D036] [D065] [D110] |
| Renewal | **2026-03-02 / 2026-03-20** | Effective **2026-04-01**, end **2027-03-31**; **$1,920** list, **10%** discount, **$1,728** net/seat. Seats not changed. Executed supplier signature is June’s. [D041] |

Conflicting summaries remain visible: March 23 digest says Ilse “acting” signed renewal with Thea despite Dana’s March 16 return; executed form names June. April 9 debrief says new discount **12%**, conflicting with signed renewal’s **10%**. October 1, 2025 CRM says green health and ARR “just over **$300k**” after 185 seats; monthly billing email says approximately $25k/month. These are source-specific statements, not replacements for exact contractual rates. [D012] [D041] [D082] [D050] [D062]

**Named-user and payment rules:** no generic/shared shift credentials; permanent reassignment for departure, role transfer, or leave over **14 consecutive days**. Additional seats in minimum **5-seat blocks**, signed addendum, prorated at discounted rate; initial commitment cannot be reduced below 140 during an active period. Fees generally noncancelable/nonrefundable subject to stated warranty/IP/cause remedies. Taxes extra. Invoice dispute notice within **20 calendar days**, undisputed sums paid Net 45, resolution effort **15 business days**. Interest **1.5%/month** or lawful maximum from day 46. Suspension requires overdue status over **15 days beyond Net 45**, notice, then **10 business days** to pay. PO boilerplate rejected. [D028]

**Continuation and legal controls:** automatic successive **12-month** periods unless written election against continuation at least **120 calendar days** before period close. Material breach cure **30 days**; insolvency proceeding not dismissed within **60 days** permits termination. Assignment ordinarily needs consent, with affiliate/M&A exceptions, written assumption, notice, and competitor/seat limits. Amendments require authorized signatures. Illinois law, Cook County venue; CISG/UCITA excluded and jury waived. [D028]

### SLA, security, and liability

- Tier 2 allows **6** designated administrators. Sev 1: **24×7×365**, human response **30 minutes**, continuous engineering, **60-minute** updates. Sev 2: Mon–Sat **05:00–23:00 Central**, response **2 hours**, updates **4 hours**. Sev 3: weekdays **07:00–19:00 Central**, excluding US federal holidays, response **8 business hours**. Sev 4: weekdays **08:00–17:00 Central**, response **2 business days**. [D028]
- Monthly uptime **99.5%**. Exclusions include Saturday **23:00–Sunday 03:00 Central** scheduled maintenance with **48-hour** notice, force majeure, customer hardware/network, third-party TMS/WMS, and authorized suspension. Credit basis is 1/12 annual net fee, stated initial monthly equivalent **$18,993.33**: **5%** for 99.00–99.49%, **10%** for 98.00–98.99%, **20%** below 98%. Claim within **30 days** after month end; sole financial uptime remedy, but below **97% for 3 consecutive months** can be material breach. [D028]
- CSV/JSON export during term; **30-day** read-only retrieval after conclusion, active database deletion within **15 days** thereafter, encrypted backup deletion within **90 days**. Prohibited uploads include PCI data, SSNs, driver-license photos, medical certifications, and regulated hazmat security plans, except standard UN/NA four-digit segregation codes. [D028]
- TLS **1.2+**, AES-**256**, tenant isolation, SAML **2.0**, MFA, RBAC; annual SOC 2 Type II examination and annual-request audit/penetration summary. Confirmed security-incident notice within **48 hours**; annually tested US multi-zone recovery, RPO **15 minutes**, RTO **4 hours**. Emergency suspension narrowed to threat, operational contact notified within **2 hours**. [D028]
- Performance warranty remedy: **30-day** correction effort, then material-failure termination/pro-rata refund. No promise of uninterrupted/error-free service or prevention of accidents, delays, or detention. IP indemnity covers valid US/Canadian rights, with modification/combination/continued superseded use/customer-data exclusions; mitigation can include **30-day** termination/refund. Customer indemnity includes data/marks claims and yard bodily/property harm except Pemberline gross negligence/willful misconduct. [D028]
- Consequential, lost revenue/profit, detention/demurrage, and supply-chain delay damages excluded. General cap: prior **12 months** net fees, initial **$227,920**; confidentiality/security disclosure super-cap **2×**, initial **$455,840**. Indemnities, undisputed fees, license restrictions, gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud excluded from caps. Article 13.2’s references to 13.3/13.4 are swapped relative to their actual headings; preserve that drafting inconsistency. Insurance: A.M. Best **A- VII**, CGL **$1m occurrence/$2m aggregate**, tech E&O/cyber **$5m**, employer liability **$1m**, umbrella **$3m**; coverage cancellation/reduction notice **30 days**. [D028]

## Tamsin Cold Chain
